title: Покемон: Пикачу зимой (2001)
alt: Зимние каникулы Пикачу (2001) / Pocket Monsters: Pikachu no Fuyuyasumi (2001) /  Pokemon: Pikachu no Fuyuyasumi (2001) / Pokemon: Pikachu's Winter Vacation (2001) Pokémon: Pikachu's Winter Vacation (2001) ピチューとピカチュウのふゆやすみ2001
description: Третий ежегодный рождественский спецвыпуск о приключениях Пикачу (Pikachu) и его друзей.

en: Pikachu's Winter Vacations are three series of videos, each composed of several Pikachu shorts. All shorts deal with winter and Christmas. This is the third and last series and contains Delibird's Dilemma, Snorlax Snowman & Trouble in Big Town.
ja: ピチューとピカチュウのふゆやすみ2001
